title: Chicken Florentine Dip
description: Make this cheesy chicken Florentine dip your go-to for parties. It's quick to make and you can easily double it for large gatherings.
ingredients: 2 (10.5 ounce) cans condensed, 98% fat-free cream of chicken soup with 30% less sodium
0.5 cup skim milk, or more as needed
1 (10 ounce) package frozen chopped spinach - thawed, drained, and squeezed dry

steps.text: Combine condensed soup, chicken, sour cream mozzarella cheese, 1/2 cup skim milk, and Parmesan cheese in a slow cooker. Add spinach, pulling it apart and shredding it as you put it in. Mix until well blended.
Cover and cook on Low until all cheeses are melted and the dip is deliciously gooey, 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Add up to 1/2 cup more milk if you feel the dip is cooking up too thick.
